name: mature_workspace
description: Realistic mature workspace -- 80 people, 20 orgs, 15 projects, 1500 events. 8 malformed events.jsonl lines at 100-107 (Sub-bug #14b shatter: 7 bare-key JSON strings + 1 truncated event). Mix of nano-epoch + human-counter seqs (Bug #41). Legacy person_added then canonical person_created (Bug #34). aliases.json carries BOTH nested and flat shapes. 4 orgs with no domains (Bug #1). For verifying substrate-hygiene migrations + defensive readers.

characteristics.first_name_collision_note: CHANGED from false, 2026-07-15. The approved placeholder vocabulary is 11 first names x 2 surnames = 22 unique full names; 80 people cannot avoid collisions. It is also the realistic shape -- an 80-person org with zero repeated first names is the 'too clean fixture' failure mode. Collisions exercise entity_resolve, which invariants.md already expects here (I7, 'fixture has multi-Daniel collision').
